name: fg-f2-world
why: F2 in world: fg::inputs submits slSetConstants and the Depth/MotionVectors/HUDLessColor tags for a fresh frame and both return 0 (frame=, const=0, tag=0), the constants line shows the near/far/fov/aspect decoded from that frame's TAA matrices, DLSS-G stays eOff (status=0x0, mode=0) and SR keeps working (engine eval ret=0x1, arg10 write eval=1 with engine MV). Trigger is a human step (launch, enter a world, walk a few seconds); a run that never enters a world reads as ABORTED because every require below is world-only. Transient 'skip=3 no-fresh-sr' / 'skip=4 no-fresh-hudless' frames at world entry, pause or resize are expected and deliberately not forbidden; the hard submit failures (token/constants/tag) are.
requires: \[fg\] inputs: frame=\d+ token=\d+ size=\d+x\d+ depth=0x[0-9a-f]+ mv=0x[0-9a-f]+ hud=0x[0-9a-f]+ const=0(?:x0+)?\b.*\btag=0(?:x0+)?\b
\[fg\] inputs: constants frame=\d+ near=-?\d+\.\d+ far=(?:-?\d+\.\d+|inf) fov=-?\d+\.\d+ aspect=-?\d+\.\d+ scaleZ=-?\d+\.\d+ bbi=\d+ reset=[01] gen=\d+
